issue_context.title: Implement web API for user badges
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

User badges where implemented in #20607. Would be good to have a web API to make use of them.

### Screenshots

_No response_

review_comments: I kept that out of this PR as I was thinking of a more complex response that would return more details about the badge than just the slug. My focus for this PR was adding/removing badges (keeping things small ;))

Overall LGTM. The only question is I don't understand what `slug` means here.

According to ChatGPT: 

> a "slug" typically refers to a short, human-readable text string that is part of a URL (Uniform Resource Locator) and is used to describe the content of a web page or resource. Slugs are often used in content management systems (CMS) and blogging platforms to create user-friendly, SEO (Search Engine Optimization)-friendly, and descriptive URLs for web pages.

> For example, in a blogging platform, if an article has the title "10 Tips for Gardening," the slug might be automatically generated as "10-tips-for-gardening," creating a URL like "example.com/blog/10-tips-for-gardening."

(I am not sure whether it is the case. Since I am not a native English speaker, so if it is the right word, my question doesn't block)

yeah, I'm using it as a readable way of using badges via API instead of just sending a list of IDs, so it is friendly to humans.
I've chosen the terminology slug because when adding an API to add/remove badges themselves they should be generally fall into the regex `[a-z0-9\-]+` which aligns with the output you had from ChatGPT
